name: Behavior
overview: Scripture reveals that behavior reflects the heart's allegiance, warning that one cannot serve both God and worldly desires (Luke 16:13). Ungodly and unrighteous conduct provokes God's wrath, as seen in the consequences of holding truth in unrighteousness and engaging in vile affections (Romans 1:18, 26). Proverbs highlights the destructive nature of disrespectful behavior, such as sowing strife and division (Proverbs 16:28), while trusting wholly in the Lord guides believers away from misguided understanding (Proverbs 3:5). God's instructions through Moses underscore the importance of obedience to His commands as foundational for proper behavior (Leviticus 18:1).
